Recorded outcome per SCC-10: the shared implementation is SHARE-ELIGIBLE-AND-EVIDENCED — a shared artifact passing all five conditions is equally conforming; this records evidence, not a sharing preference.

debt:R2-UNAPPLIED-WRITE-EFFECT-SOURCE-ORDER — recon-confirmed over-degradation, fail-closed only (no wrong answer ever publishes): `function f(x: string | number) { return { b: x, a: (x = "s") }; }` degrades a correct `string | number` to UnappliedWriteEffect / ReturnOnly because the evaluator seeds the degradation for ANY whole-slot write into a value-selected/parameter slot without applying write effects. Durable owner: the narrowing / value-inference work on this same graph (U6.NARROW_SUBSTITUTION / U6.VALUE_INFERENCE own actual write-effect application; sound suppression needs evaluation-order reasoning across function boundaries). Resolution gate: no later than the U6 lane close — the U6 lane may not close with this entry open. Acceptance test (owed with the owning work): flow_return_source_order_object_read_before_write_publishes_clean — `{ b: x, a: (x = "s") }` publishes `{ b: string | number; a: string }` CLEAN + warm-admissible, WITH the deferred-read negative `{ b: () => x, a: (x = "s") }` still observing the write (`b: () => string`). The proposed span-comparison suppression (drop the degradation when every read span precedes the write span) is REJECTED AS UNSOUND: the deferred closure read observes the write despite preceding it in source (recon-executed against tsc 7.0.2 + pinned tsgo, both agreeing).

debt:CONDITIONAL-VAR-BRANCH-JOIN — recon-confirmed over-degradation, fail-closed only (no wrong answer ever publishes): `function f(flag: boolean) { if (flag) var x: any = 1; else var x: any = "s"; return x; }` and `function f(flag: boolean) { if (flag) { var y: number | undefined = 1; } return y; }` degrade a usable value to ConditionalVarDefinition / ReturnOnly because the FUNCTION-scoped `var` layer survives the `if`-arm restore (as it must — `var` hoists), while nothing folds the arms: the surviving reaching definition is the last-evaluated arm's rather than the join over every arm and the never-assigned path. Durable owner: the narrowing work on this same graph (U6.NARROW_* own the join algebra, built on the shared FlowFrame lattice over the ONE FunctionFlowGraph's narrowing-predicate edge class — never a second flow structure; a merge algebra over the evaluator's `locals` / `var_locals` maps IS that second structure and is REJECTED AS OUT OF CONTRACT). Resolution gate: no later than the U6 lane close — the U6 lane may not close with this entry open. Acceptance tests (owed with the owning work): branchVar — `if (flag) var x: any = 1; else var x: any = "s"; return x` publishes `any` CLEAN + warm-admissible; branchVarUndef — `if (flag) { var y: number | undefined = 1; } return y` publishes `number | undefined` CLEAN + warm-admissible. Accepted cost until then: `if (flag) { var w = 1 } return w` returned a coincidentally-correct warm `number` and is now degraded — tsc REJECTS that program (TS2454, used before being assigned), so fail-closed is the correct trade.
ruling:F1 (hold as IMPLEMENTED_UNLANDED / REBASE_REQUIRED; never landed)
